references.text: Repeats the counting of the tribe of Reuben with the same number: 46,500 men
The second census of the tribe of Reuben in the plains of Moab, showing 43,730 men—a decrease from the first census
Reuben's birth as Jacob's firstborn son with Leah
Reuben's sons who went to Egypt, the origin of the tribe
Jacob's blessing over Reuben, describing his position as the firstborn
